description: Identical for every seed; only the random seed differs. Story structure (leads, decoys, witnesses, evolution) is drawn from these ranges by the seed.

ground_truth_policy.relevant_leads: perpetrator (grade 3) and accomplices (grade 2) chosen by the generator, independent of any ranking method
ground_truth_policy.must_flag: planted claims (person near the incident) whose supporting evidence, as recorded by the generator, includes the changed evidence
ground_truth_policy.must_not_flag: findings that involve no entity touched by any record citing the changed evidence
ground_truth_policy.indeterminate: all other findings (involve a touched entity but are not planted claims); reported, never counted as errors
